title: Add Rename option to bulk action bar and three-dot menu in My Files

requirements.text: In the My Files section, add a 'Rename' action button to the bulk selection action bar, positioned immediately before the existing 'Move' button. The Rename action in bulk mode should open a rename dialog (or trigger rename for the selected item if only one is selected). Include an appropriate rename icon on the button.

quotes: Selection - Bulk action bar (currently : Download, Move, Delete,) - add a "Rename" right before the "Move"

acceptanceCriteria: The bulk action bar displays buttons in the order: Download, Rename, Move, Delete.
The 'Rename' button has a rename/edit icon.
Clicking 'Rename' in the bulk action bar opens the rename dialog when one item is selected.
The Rename button is visible whenever items are selected and the bulk action bar is shown.

requirements.text: In the My Files section, add a 'Rename' menu item to the vertical three-dot (ellipsis) context menu for each file/folder row, positioned immediately before the existing 'Move' item. Clicking it should open the rename dialog for that file or folder. Include an appropriate rename icon.

quotes: Vertical three dots (currently: Preview, Move, Delete) - add a " "Rename" right before the "Move"

acceptanceCriteria: The three-dot context menu displays items in the order: Preview, Rename, Move, Delete.
The 'Rename' menu item has a rename/edit icon.
Clicking 'Rename' opens a rename dialog pre-filled with the current file or folder name.
After confirming the rename, the file or folder name updates in the list and a success toast is shown.
The rename dialog includes validation (e.g., non-empty name) and shows an error toast on failure.

constraints: Do not change the order of existing actions (Download, Move, Delete in bulk bar; Preview, Move, Delete in three-dot menu) — only insert Rename before Move.
Reuse existing rename dialog components (RenameFileDialog / RenameFolderDialog) where they already exist.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding Rename to any section other than My Files (e.g., Trash, Recent, Shared).
Implementing bulk rename for multiple selected items simultaneously.
Backend changes — rename mutations already exist.
